title: Factorized head x layer MLA Mirror code
hypothesis: Factorized head x layer Mirror coordinates reconstruct held-out MLA KV roles from one shared latent basis with fewer bytes than flat tables without role collapse.
mirror_coordinate: factorized head and layer scalar address
logical_multiplicity: 12 KV role maps; six held out

development.selection_metric: heldout map nMSE, distinct functions, actual bytes

fresh.reason: Direct coefficients are exact specificity control.

success_gate: Heldout nMSE <=1e-6, all six heldout roles distinct, >=20% fewer bytes than flat and >=10% fewer than direct coefficients.

boundaries: no attention-weighted metric or real MLA claim
